design_brief.problem_statement: Finalize explicit cross-domain ownership for identity/session, authorization, reference frames, simulation time, spatial addressing, material identity, world operations, world queries, lifecycle, work budgeting, compatibility and security without duplicate truth ownership.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical main f6d68fc7c594b371f48a9bcff056e2478e04f317 is GLOBAL-P0 R2 at registry generation 78. H0.1 passed; C22 is MAIN_INTEGRATED; the H0.1 runtime slot is RELEASED. CH9.6 is accepted/frozen; ECO is advisory/research; CH->NX remains a future NX dependency gate. R3 is not promoted.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Finalize prepared R3 from exact current main. Frozen R2 evidence remains historical evidence; all new post-promotion runtime work begins from one canonical R3 base after mandatory post-R3 control verification.
alternatives_considered: REJECTED: one global WorldManager owning cross-domain truth. This would create duplicate/implicit ownership over accepted domain foundations and violate CANONICAL WORLD separation.

REJECTED: reuse existing domain identifiers as universal global identifiers (for example peer/entity/cell/frame/authority identities). This would conflate identity, transport, spatial addressing and authority semantics.
REJECTED: make WT a second transaction coordinator. WT instead compiles WorldOperation intents into the existing M0 atomic commit engine so canonical commit truth remains single-owned.
REJECTED: make WQ a global canonical world database. WQ instead plans actor-scoped reads through domain adapters and owns no canonical store.

REJECTED: make WB an authority owner, production runtime scheduler or development scheduler. WB is limited to work-budget/quality/defer/dispatch policy; authority and MAIN/HARNESS development control remain separate.

REJECTED: treat H0.3 as a game-runtime scheduler. H0.3 remains the DEVELOPMENT multi-worker Work-Order scheduler/control layer and does not own gameplay authority, simulation/game time or production boot.
REJECTED: let V0 create canonical composition truth. V0 remains a composition/presentation/readback consumer of existing domain truth.
REJECTED: reuse ECO as the economy program identifier. ECO remains Evolutionary Ecology advisory/research; ECON is reserved for future economy/markets/contracts.

REJECTED: immediately rewrite stable ITEM/MATTER/G/NX or other accepted foundations under new R3 names. R3 adds only named cross-domain contracts/adapters and preserves existing canonical truth owners.
design_brief.selected_design: Retain prepared R3 cross-domain foundations, preserve domain truth owners, reserve ECO for Evolutionary Ecology and ECON for economy, and activate new waves only after human-gated canonical promotion.
design_brief.why_selected: This design preserves existing canonical truth owners while adding only named cross-domain contracts/adapters; avoids duplicate global truth and hidden managers; keeps identity, authority, routing, compute, transport and presentation distinct; reuses M0 as the sole atomic commit engine under WT; keeps V0 consumer-only and H0.3 development-only; separates ECO from ECON; and permits staged Wave A/Wave B activation from one canonical post-promotion base instead of forcing a simultaneous rewrite.
affected_owners: MAIN/HARNESS — preserves project state, checkpoint/evidence/review routing and development Work-Order authorization; R3 interaction is through control gates only; ownership transfer=NO.
ITEM — preserves permanent Item identity and Item Graph semantics; MAT/WT/WQ may reference or adapt Item truth without replacing it; ownership transfer=NO.
MATTER — preserves authoritative mutable material/volume truth and durable Matter transactions; MAT/WT/WQ intersect through shared identity/operations/query adapters; ownership transfer=NO.
CONSTRUCTION — preserves construct/part/bond truth; MAT/WT/WQ provide shared contracts without absorbing Construction semantics; ownership transfer=NO.
G — preserves deterministic procedural natural baseline and Geo feature/field contracts; RF/SD/MAT/WB intersect as contracts and G9 remains separately gated; ownership transfer=NO.
NX — preserves realtime transport/replication policy; IAM/RF/WB interactions do not transfer gameplay truth, identity truth or authority; ownership transfer=NO.
AUTHORITY — preserves authority leases/epochs/routing; IAM/RF/SD/WB remain distinct from authority ownership; ownership transfer=NO.
M0 — preserves the atomic multi-domain commit engine; WT compiles plans into M0 and never becomes a second coordinator; ownership transfer=NO.
S1 — preserves proposal-only distributed compute; WB may dispatch work but workers remain non-authoritative; ownership transfer=NO.
R3_M0_MW — preserves persistence/replay/recovery durability semantics; COMPAT/WT integrations must preserve accepted commit/recovery behavior; ownership transfer=NO.
V0 — composition/presentation/readback consumer only; consumes accepted domain capabilities and creates no private canonical world/item/network truth; ownership transfer=NO.

H0.3 — DEVELOPMENT multi-worker Work-Order scheduler/control layer only; does not become game-runtime scheduling, gameplay authority, simulation/game-time or production-boot ownership; ownership transfer=NO.
ECO — preserves Evolutionary Ecology advisory/research semantics; may later consume MAT/TF/LIFE/WB/environment adapters; ownership transfer=NO.
ECON_FUTURE — reserved future economy/markets/contracts semantics; consumes physical Item/MAT/WT truth without duplicate resource accounting; ownership transfer=NO.

AI_FUTURE, NAV_FUTURE, ENV_FUTURE, POP_FUTURE, SP_FUTURE and ORG_FUTURE — retain their declared future domain semantics while consuming named R3 foundations through adapters/contracts; no R3 foundation becomes a second owner of those domains; ownership transfer=NO.

non_goals: No architecture promotion in this branch
No Wave A production branches before the human promotion gate
No replacement of M0, Item, Matter, Construction, G, NX or S1 truth owners
expected_risks: CRITICAL: duplicate canonical truth ownership or an implicit global manager. Mitigation: explicit ownership manifest, forbidden duplicate foundation tokens, named adapter/intersection boundaries and independent ownership review.

CRITICAL: identity/authority conflation. Mitigation: AccountId/PrincipalId/SessionId remain distinct from NetworkPeerId, PlayerEntityId and AuthorityLeaseId; AUTHZ does not replace domain semantic validation.
CRITICAL: reference-frame identity becoming authority routing. Mitigation: RF owns frame identity/transforms only; ReferenceFrameId != AuthorityRegionId and AUTHORITY remains the routing/lease owner.

CRITICAL: simulation time becoming work/development scheduling. Mitigation: TF separates simulation/domain time from wall/network/presentation clocks; WB is work-budget policy and MAIN/HARNESS owns development scheduling.
CRITICAL: WT becoming a second commit coordinator. Mitigation: WT only compiles WorldOperation/WorldTransactionPlan into existing M0 atomic commit semantics.
CRITICAL: WQ becoming a canonical world store. Mitigation: actor-scoped query planning through domain adapters; WQ owns no canonical database.
CRITICAL: WB becoming authority or a game-runtime/development scheduler. Mitigation: WORLD_WORK_BUDGET_NE_AUTHORITY plus explicit separation from MAIN/HARNESS and domain runtime scheduling.
CRITICAL: V0 becoming a truth owner. Mitigation: V0 is composition/presentation/readback consumer-only and may not introduce private terrain/item/network truth.
CRITICAL: H0.3 becoming gameplay/runtime scheduling or game-time authority. Mitigation: H0.3 is explicitly DEVELOPMENT Work-Order control only and excluded from production boot/runtime ownership.
CRITICAL: ECO/ECON identifier collision. Mitigation: ECO is reserved for Evolutionary Ecology; ECON_FUTURE is reserved for economy/markets/contracts.

CRITICAL: stale SHA, stale registry generation or historical evidence authorizing promotion/new work. Mitigation: stale authorization fails closed; exact current-main facts and external exact-head evidence are required.
CRITICAL: cross-branch dependency drift. Mitigation: standard/directional PC0, watched/critical_watched paths and fresh dependency revalidation at the consuming checkpoint.
CRITICAL: post-promotion branches starting from different canonical bases. Mitigation: Wave A branches start from one accepted canonical R3 main base or an explicitly audited descendant.

CRITICAL: NX.C1 starting before post-R3 gates. Mitigation: NX.C1 remains blocked until canonical R3, mandatory post-R3 PC0 and fresh H0.2/NX.C1 dispatch; CH->NX is revalidated before NX source acceptance.

IAM.purpose: Account/principal/session identities separate from peer/world identity.

AUTHZ.purpose: Policy decision boundary; domain owners retain semantic validation.

RF.purpose: Reference-frame identity/transforms separate from authority routing.

TF.purpose: Simulation/domain time separate from wall/network/presentation clocks.

WT.purpose: Compile WorldOperation intents to existing M0 atomic commit semantics, never a second coordinator.

WQ.purpose: Actor-scoped cross-domain query planning without canonical-store ownership.

WB.purpose: Work budget/quality/dispatch policy without authority ownership or development scheduling.

ECO.purpose: Evolutionary Ecology advisory/research; not economy or production scheduler.

ECON.purpose: Reserved future physical economy/markets/contracts on Item/MAT/WT truth.
